visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a promotional poster for Mister Donut in Japan. The poster features a smiling woman with her hair tied back, holding a small round donut. The background of the poster is blue with pink and yellow graphic elements. Bright, flat lighting illuminates the scene. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a McDonald's. A digital menu board hangs above a counter, showing various breakfast muffins and pancakes with prices in Yen. A person wearing a black beanie and a beige coat stands with their back to the camera. (3) A display case at a Mister Donut shop is shown, filled with several rows of pink 'Mochirin' donuts packaged in wrappers featuring a cute character face. The lighting is bright and clear, highlighting the soft texture of the pastries. (4) A white box containing four distinct donuts is presented: a soy-sauce glazed one, a kinako-dusted one, a red bean filled one, and a brown sugar variety. A hand reaches in to pick up the glazed donut. (5) A close-up shot shows a hand holding a piece of the soy-sauce glazed donut, which has a glossy, dark syrup on top. The background is a blurred cafe setting with wooden tables. (6) A yellow and red patterned paper bag from Marugame Seimen is shown, containing 'Udon Fries'. A hand pulls out a single, long, wavy fried udon noodle against a background of green indoor plants. (7) A young woman with dark hair and a white sweater is seen taking a bite of the fried udon noodle. She is in a well-lit indoor food court or cafe. (8) A tray with a McDonald's breakfast is shown, including a McGriddle burger in its wrapper, a hash brown, a cup of coffee, and a cold drink. The camera zooms in on the McGriddle, showing the 'M' logo branded on the pancake bun. (9) A hand breaks the McGriddle burger in half, revealing a folded egg and a sausage patty with melted cheese inside. The interior lighting is warm and inviting.
